name: Govee Smart Space Heater with RGB Night Light (Model H7131) - 1500W Wi-Fi App Control
description: Selling a Govee Smart Space Heater (Model: H7131) [Govee Official Store](https://www.amazon.com/stores/Govee/page/955085B3-85CC-417B-AD85-4028F36EFEAB). This compact and powerful 1500W ceramic PTC tabletop heater features rapid 3-second heating, wide-angle oscillation, 4 distinct heating/fan modes, and a customizable built-in RGB night light ring at the base. It fully integrates with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth to connect to the Govee Home app, Alexa, and Google Assistant for effortless remote automation, schedules, and voice controls. It includes built-in physical tip-over safety sensors. **Important Voluntary Recall Transparency**: Please be aware that Govee and the CPSC issued a voluntary recall for the H7131 series due to potential wireless firmware overheating risks under specific unmonitored scenarios [CPSC Government Recall Notice](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2025/GoveeLife-and-Govee-Smart-Electric-Space-Heaters-Recalled-Due-to-Fire-and-Burn-Hazards-Imported-by-Govee). This unit remains fully assembled, entirely functional, and works flawlessly when monitored or operated manually via touch controls. It is sold strictly **AS-IS** for parts, bench testing, or standard usage at the buyer's own risk, which is heavily reflected in the low clearance price. Naturally, this comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a cat. The exterior housing and grilles have been thoroughly blown out, wiped down, and sanitized. It does NOT come with secondary retail storage bags or the original box, so local pickup buyers, please bring a transport tote.
contact_note: Sold completely AS-IS due to official model recall. Fully pre-assembled and functional. Lightweight and small enough to fit inside any standard bag or vehicle. From a cat-friendly apartment.

name_zh: Govee H7131 智能桌面小暖风机 / 氛围灯无线电暖器 (1500W 黑色)
description_zh: 清仓低价转让一台功能强劲的 Govee 智能桌面小型电暖器（官方型号：H7131）[Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/Govee/comments/ys8plv/70_govee_space_heater_vs_generic/)。具备 1500W 陶瓷 PTC 核心，支持 3 秒极速出热、自动左右摇头、4 档风速模式，且底部自带可自定义的 RGB 炫彩氛围小夜灯。整机内置 Wi-Fi 与蓝牙芯片，能无缝接入 Govee Home 手机 App 以及 Alexa、Google Assistant 进行远程自动化定时和语音控制。机身配有防跌倒自动断电物理保护。**【重要官方召回透明披露】**：请买家知悉，Govee 品牌方联合美国 CPSC 消费品安全委员会针对 H7131 全系列发布了自愿性召回通知（因无线遥控固件存在极端不规范使用下的过热火灾隐患）[Govee 官方召回说明](https://recall.goveelife.com/heater-recall)。本暖风机目前硬件结构完好、通电加热完全正常，通过顶部物理触控面板手动使用没有任何问题。现作为**AS-IS（现状售出不退换）**产品进行零部件拆解或日常手动监护下低价清仓，请买家自行评估使用风险。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前已使用气吹对进出风滤网进行了深层除尘并进行了表面酒精擦拭消毒。本暖器不附带原厂纸箱包装或收纳袋，本地自提的买家朋友请自带一个小提袋将其带走。
